Teacher points to the five words on the board. Students repeat the words once.
Teacher models run in place. Students copy the action twice.
Teacher jumps once. Students jump once on the count of three.
Teacher says sit and stand. Students change position with the teacher.
Teacher says stop. Students freeze. Repeat three times.
Teacher gives one-word commands. Students act immediately.
Choral drill. Teacher says each word. Students repeat and do the action.
Students work in pairs. One gives a single command. The other performs it. Then they switch.
Students answer together, then check with the teacher.
Whole-class check. Teacher gives random commands. Students show the action quickly.
